question: Which of the following is another name of folic acid?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pteroylglutamic acid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Folic acid**** **is also known as **pteroylglutamic acid.**
 
• Folic acid is a type of Vitamin used to cure some diseases like anaemia.
 
• Vitamin B9 also called folate or folic acid is one of 8 B vitamins. ​
 
• Its deficiency in the body causes the impaired formation of red blood cells, weakness, irritability, headache.
